text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: “—Huh, is Espoir City alone today?”

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: "That's unusual... Even when injured, that Trainer always stayed by her side..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... a falling out?
I mean, Espoir City can be
pretty rough around the edges..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Either way, it's probably gonna affect
the upcoming Mile CS Nambu Hai...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... ha—
Don't look down on me...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely gonna win the Nambu Hai, too!
I'm strong! I can do this all on my own!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (—Even if you say that...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Coming up with training menus is such a paiiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "I know she gave me the general outline! And taught me how to think it through! But calculating every little thing is such a drag!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Urrrgh.......
Today's training is supposed to simulate
the final stretch, soooo.......!
"Now, while running, be mindful of the angle of your shoulder blades."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: And then, um...
"First, let's start with shifting your center of gravity during acceleration!"
"Today, I'm gonna build up some foot power!"
"Today, I'll train my foot power!"
“Take a break and stay hydrated!”
“Take a break and make sure to stay hydrated!”
"You can make yourself the right answer."
"‘You can make yourself the right answer.’"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I saaid I get it already.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I know.
I already understand.
And on the final day of summer training camp.

Though only for a short time, I attend
Espoir City's training session.

She has forbidden me from setting up training equipment
or working late into the night for now.
Thanks to that, my body has recovered quite a bit.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...I tried doing some
'adjustments' too, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"The Teio Sho was clockwise,
but the Mile Championship Nambu Hai is counter-clockwise, right?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
So……
I made some adjustments to make my right kick even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I just thought maybe I could corner better that way.
choice_data_list: ...! You figured that out yourself, too?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
M-My time improved too, okay?!
Go check it later, damn it!

I take the notebook from Espoir City.
Inside, the training regimen she tackled this summer
was recorded in meticulous detail.

"Even if I had spoken up,
I surely would have given her the exact same guidance."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...He... heheh!
Well, yeah! It's only natural I could do it!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Just wait and see what I can do when it really counts!

Her profile bathed in the sunlight radiated
a strength and confidence that hadn't been
there back then.
(Vrrrroooom...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
We'll be at the academy soon.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"You get ready too...
Wait, you're asleep?! ...Good grief."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...Just sit back and watch. Watch your trainee, Espoir City."
